Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Boarding House 3 NPC Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120?tab=description]Boarding House and Bus Stop Extension[/url] mod NPC (Gregory, Sheila, Joel ), Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait.
Including seasonal outfit portraits.

Find where you installed your Boarding House mod (somewhere in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the folders from my zip [b]([CP] Boarding House, [STF] Buffalo's Ranch, [TMX] Boarding House)[/b] to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[BH] Boarding House[/b] folder to overwrite the folders in it for it to work. 



23/08/2021: Uploaded content Patcher version.
I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file doesn't work for you, try this version.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120?tab=description]Boarding House and Bus Stop Extension[/url]﻿ mod.)
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]


The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120?tab=description]Boarding House and Bus Stop Extension[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60742951]TrentXV[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
